visualCharacteristics.purpose: two fixed columns pairing a heading and text with a video, photo, icon list or embedded form

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: [heading + text | media]; a media cell holding only a YouTube/Vimeo/.mp4 link becomes an embedded player, only a /fragments/ link loads that fragment (e.g. a form), only an image is shown full width; paragraphs that start with a small icon image render as icon + text items

usage: Story or intro text beside a video, a photo beside icon highlights, or text beside a sign-up form.
reuseGuidance: Use for a fixed text-plus-media pair. Use columns-sidebar when the second column is a narrow promo sidebar, columns-panel for the dark boxed version.
